cases.sentence: Князь Андрей, поглядывая на Пьера, прерывал изредка молчание речами, доказывавшими, что он находился в ___ духа.
cases.explain: «хорошем расположении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: In the evening Andréy and Pierre got into the open carriage and drove to Bald Hills. Prince Andréy, glancing at Pierre, broke the silence now and then with remarks which showed that he was in a good temper.

cases.sentence: Он говорил ему, указывая на поля, о своих ___.
cases.explain: «хозяйственных усовершенствованиях» — after the preposition «о», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Pointing to the fields, he spoke of the improvements he was making in his husbandry.

cases.sentence: Пьер думал о том, что князь Андрей несчастлив, что он заблуждается, что он не знает ___ и что Пьер должен притти на помощь ему, просветить и поднять его.
cases.explain: «истинного света» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He was thinking that Prince Andréy was unhappy, had gone astray, did not see the true light, and that he, Pierre, ought to aid, enlighten, and raise him. But as soon as he thought of what he should say, he felt that Prince Andréy with one word, one argument, would upset all his teaching, and he shrank from beginning, afraid of exposing to possible ridicule what to him was precious and sacred.

cases.sentence: — Только наше святое братство имеет ___ в жизни; всё остальное есть сон, — говорил Пьер.
cases.explain: «действительный смысл» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Only our holy brotherhood has the real meaning of life, all the rest is a dream,” said Pierre. “Understand, my dear fellow, that outside this union all is filled with deceit and falsehood and I agree with you that nothing is left for an intelligent and good man but to live out his life, like you, merely trying not to harm others. But make our fundamental convictions your own, join our brotherhood, give yourself up to us, let yourself be guided, and you will at once feel yourself, as I have felt myself, a part of that vast invisible chain the beginning of which is hidden in heaven,” said Pierre.

cases.sentence: По ___, загоревшемуся в глазах князя Андрея, и по его молчанию Пьер видел, что слова его не напрасны, что князь Андрей не перебьет его и не будет смеяться над его словами.
cases.explain: «особенному блеску» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Prince Andréy, looking straight in front of him, listened in silence to Pierre’s words. More than once, when the noise of the wheels prevented his catching what Pierre said, he asked him to repeat it, and by the peculiar glow that came into Prince Andréy’s eyes and by his silence, Pierre saw that his words were not in vain and that Prince Andréy would not interrupt him or laugh at what he said.

cases.sentence: — повторил князь Андрей, но Пьер не дал ему времени ответить и принял это повторение за отрицание, тем более, что он знал прежние ___ князя Андрея.
cases.explain: «атеистические убеждения» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “A future life?” Prince Andréy repeated, but Pierre, giving him no time to reply, took the repetition for a denial, the more readily as he knew Prince Andréy’s former atheistic convictions.

cases.sentence: Разве я не чувствую, что я в этом огромном ___ существ, в которых проявляется Божество, — высшая сила, как хотите, — что я составлю одно звено, одну ступень от низших существ к высшим?
cases.explain: «бесчисленном количестве» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “You say you can’t see a reign of goodness and truth on earth. Nor could I, and it cannot be seen if one looks on our life here as the end of everything. On earth, here on this earth” (Pierre pointed to the fields), “there is no truth, all is false and evil; but in the universe, in the whole universe there is a kingdom of truth, and we who are now the children of earth are—eternally—children of the whole universe. Don’t I feel in my soul that I am part of this vast harmonious whole? Don’t I feel that I form one link, one step, between the lower and higher beings, in this vast harmonious multitude of beings in whom the Deity—the Supreme Power if you prefer the term—is manifest? If I see, clearly see, that ladder leading from plant to man, why should I suppose it breaks off at me and does not go farther and farther? I feel that I cannot vanish, since nothing vanishes in this world, but that I shall always exist and always have existed. I feel that beyond me and above me there are spirits, and that in this world there is truth.”

cases.sentence: Князь Андрей стоял, облокотившись на перила парома и, слушая Пьера, не спуская глаз, смотрел на ___ солнца по синеющему разливу.
cases.explain: «красный отблеск» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “If there is a God and future life, there is truth and good, and man’s highest happiness consists in striving to attain them. We must live, we must love, and we must believe that we live not only today on this scrap of earth, but have lived and shall live forever, there, in the Whole,” said Pierre, and he pointed to the sky. Prince Andréy stood leaning on the railing of the raft listening to Pierre, and he gazed with his eyes fixed on the red reflection of the sun gleaming on the blue waters. There was perfect stillness. Pierre became silent. The raft had long since stopped and only the waves of the current beat softly against it below. Prince Andréy felt as if the sound of the waves kept up a refrain to Pierre’s words, whispering:

cases.sentence: Паром давно пристал, и только волны теченья с ___ ударялись о дно парома.
cases.explain: «слабым звуком» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.

cases.sentence: Князь Андрей вздохнул, и лучистым, детским, нежным взглядом взглянул в раскрасневшееся восторженное, но всё робкое перед ___, лицо Пьера.
cases.explain: «первенствующим другом» — after the preposition «перед», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “It is true, believe it.” He sighed, and glanced with a radiant, childlike, tender look at Pierre’s face, flushed and rapturous, but yet shy before his superior friend.
